purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for Element definitions/instances, resource/operation bindings, schema/localization/style refs and validation findings.

topics.name: Expose Elements Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for Element definitions/instances, resource/operation bindings, schema/localization/style refs and validation findings.

semantics.identity_rule: Element definition, rendered instance, represented resource, operation, route and style/label identities remain distinct.
semantics.binding_rule: Visual graph/list shows only explicit bindings.
semantics.action_rule: Edit/rebind/style/localize operations invoke separate authorized editors/operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing Elements grants no resource mutation or invocation authority.
semantics.validation_rule: Monitor surfaces unresolved bindings, hard-coded UI strings, schema mismatches and effectful navigation violations.
semantics.layout_rule: DOM/layout adjacency never appears as a semantic binding unless explicitly declared.

invariants.rule: Expose Elements are reusable human-interface primitives that project or invoke explicitly bound semantics; visual form, nesting, focus, color, position or enabled-looking state never creates ownership, authority or domain meaning.

hard_gates.condition: monitor invents binding from DOM adjacency

prose.summary: Define a read-only Expose monitor for Element definitions/instances, resource/operation bindings, schema/localization/style refs and validation findings.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against Web Base, Form/GUI Editor, localization and canonical style contracts.
